name: ✧The Ghastly Gulp of Fungi Grove✧
source:
Something's wrong with Fungi Grove!  




To discover why, Tiny elf Tilia and her planty friend Bulb-Plop must use a Magical Mushroom Field Guide✧˖°

...But how will the mushrooms lead them to what's behind the strange happenings in Fungi Grove?

[From [url=https://shrubbery-droll.itch.io/the-ghastly-gulp-of-fungi-grove]Itch.io[/url]]
